thread:
taylor_sales: heads-up -> NovaHealth wants a 7-day POC. They asked for Dedicated pool + SSO and strict RBAC. Can we scope minimal perms?

sam_se: yes. plan to create `poc_readonly` (metrics/audit) and `poc_executor` (inference calls only). No file uploads and no model finetuning.

gina_security: require ephemeral invites (7d), KMS-backed keys for any non-ephemeral tokens, audit export available on demand, and explicit PHI ban during POC. Also need AIA signed before granting executor role.

mohit_platform: we can provision pool `nh-ded-01` and bind tokens to it. CLI invite example: 
```
redwood invite --email claire@novahealth.com --role poc_executor --expires 2026-06-08T09:00:00Z --restrict-pool nh-ded-01
```
Hosted API keys allowed only for smoke tests (1h TTL, `--no-data-retain`).

taylor_sales: client wants hosted keys first for quick tests. We'll require the AIA prior to Dedicated access.

sam_se: additional guardrails: restrict model family to `rwd-q*`, enable rotate-on-use, and disable external callbacks for the pool.

gina_security: add revoke flow and contact list. If compromised: immediate token revoke + pool key rotation. Provide KMS policy screenshot if asked.

mohit_platform: revoke commands: `POST /admin/tokens/revoke?filter=role:poc_*` then `POST /admin/pools/nh-ded-01/rotate-keys`. I'll add a one-shot revoke script to the internal gist. infra-bot: gist created: https://internal.gists/redwood/nova-poc-playbook

taylor_sales: perfect. I'll collect the AIA and confirm PHI prohibition with NovaHealth. Will share attendee emails DM.

sam_se: also scheduling nightly audit that flags any token >2h TTL and a cleanup job to remove `poc_*` accounts 10 days after expiry.

gina_security: thanks everyone. cc legal when AIA is sent.
